estimator.name: pathopress_model_agnostic_chat_v1
estimator.input_serialization: canonical JSON of the request messages array
estimator.best: ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4) + 3 tokens per message + 3 reply-priming tokens
estimator.base: ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 3) + 6 tokens per message + 6 reply-priming tokens
estimator.worst: UTF-8 bytes + 32 tokens per message + 64 reply-priming tokens
estimator.output_best: compact JSON with every query value rendered as 0
estimator.output_base: compact JSON with every query value rendered as 72.5
estimator.scope_note: The worst heuristic is conservative for common byte-backed tokenizers but is not a formal upper bound for every possible proprietary tokenizer or chat template.

source.title: Controlled snapshot adaptation of the pinned Microsoft BenchPress invocation contract

snapshot_source.title: OpenAI GPT-5.5 model documentation

profile.reproducibility_note: This freezes a snapshot identity for a reproducible future run. The snapshot substitution was not recorded by upstream and therefore must not be reported as an exact historical BenchPress model invocation.

source.title: OpenAI Batch API reference
source.limits_note: Request-count and file-byte limits are transport limits; enqueued-token capacity is model-specific and intentionally unset.

batch_queue_feasibility.note: The literal upstream contract uses online Chat Completions. Batch feasibility is only decision-bearing when an explicit batch execution profile and its limits are selected.

capacity.transport_scope_note: For OpenAI Batch, byte/hash checks use the exact canonical Batch JSONL wire plan and are compared with the offline adapter materialization manifest.
